coverageNotes: Measures ID-keyed record composition only. Nested coordinate arrays and other source containers remain unconverted. Correlated tagged unions are covered by 001-data_modeling/010-discriminated_union.

questions.context: Using Convex SDK 1.44.0, field `c` must contain an object whose keys are document IDs from the `example` table. Each value is exactly an object with required `z: ArrayBuffer`. An empty record is allowed. `v` is imported from `convex/values`.
questions.question: Which validator represents `c`?

options.rationale: The record validates both example-table ID keys and object values containing bytes.
The unrestricted string key accepts arbitrary strings and IDs from other tables.
An array changes the required keyed object container.
The record value must be an object containing z; this validator expects bare bytes.
